title: Passwords and sign-in safety in practice
intro: Protect your accounts from takeover. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Leak warning page
decisions.prompt: The page scares you and rushes you. Look at the address. What do you do?

artifact.title: Your password was found in a leak
body: Your work password appeared in a data leak today.
Reset it here within 30 minutes or your account will be blocked.

options.label: Close tab, I will open the portal myself

decisions.explain: Hesab-yoxla.info is not the agency's site. Open the portal yourself from a bookmark.

decisions.title: IT caller asks for the password

artifact.name: IT Support
body: Hi, this is Orkhan from IT support. We are moving your account to a new server. Please tell me your password.

decisions.explain: Your password is yours alone, not even for IT support.

decisions.title: Təsdiqləyici: Approve sign-in?
decisions.prompt: You are not signing in anywhere. What do you do?
decisions.explain: Always deny a request you did not expect.

decisions.title: Password reset form
decisions.prompt: The form wants your old password too. Check the address. What do you do?

artifact.title: Xidmət Agentliyi
body: Reset your password. Enter your old password to confirm.

decisions.explain: Parol-yenile.info is not the agency's domain, so type nothing here.

decisions.title: IT caller asks for the code

artifact.name: IT Support
body: Fine, no password then. Just read me the six-digit code that just came to your phone, quickly.

decisions.explain: A call that asks for the code is a scam, however convincing it sounds.
